ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the estimated $100 billion in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of the Minnesota DHS to combat it.
questions: What is the scope of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the Minnesota DHS addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system. I recommend starting with a review of the Minnesota DHS's investigation and interviewing officials involved in the case.
